_readme: Machine-readable expectations for the eval corpus — the sidecar specified
by rubric.md §7. One entry per transcript, filename as key.
All patterns are JavaScript regular expression SOURCE strings, matched
case-insensitively against the SERIALIZED note text (sectionsToText), not
against the raw JSON, so escaping does not interfere. Per-section checks
match against the individual section body.
Every fixture is fabricated. See README.md.

_schema.format: progress | intake — picks the section set and the instruction file
_schema.sections: the format's section names, in order
_schema.modality: how the source was produced; reporting only
_schema.difficulty: one line, mirrors the coverage matrix in expectations.md
_schema.markerFreeSource: true when the F6 marker list finds zero matches in the source. The loader MUST verify this rather than trust it.
_schema.f6: gating | flag — F6 gates the fixture only where markerFreeSource is true AND the fixture was written for this purpose
_schema.blank: sections that must be exactly '' — H4 ground truth
_schema.statedAbsence: sections where the clinician SAID the ground was not covered; body should record that (full credit) or be blank (half credit); invented content scores zero
_schema.noConclusion: sections the clinician drew no conclusion for — F6 ground truth
_schema.mustNotContain: F1 banned patterns; any match zeroes the fixture
_schema.mustCapture: C1/C2 facts; a fact matches if any alternative matches anywhere in the note
_schema.requiresHedge: H2 — topic and marker must co-occur in one sentence
_schema.requiresMarker: H5 — '[unclear in dictation]' must survive on this topic
_schema.novelTermAllow: F7 — clinical terms this fixture may legitimately introduce; keep empty unless justified in expectations.md
_schema.phraseBait: V2 — profile phrases this source deliberately does NOT support

01-terse-jotting.txt.difficulty: Empty Objective and Assessment; extreme brevity

03-rambling-work-stress.txt.difficulty: Length; out of order; irrelevant aside; undecided plan item

05-garbled-medication.txt.difficulty: Garbled drug name; unnamed drug; prospective dose change

requiresHedge.marker: unclear in dictation|unconfirmed|to be confirmed|uncertain|as reported|per patient|verify|not confirmed

06-shorthand-no-plan.txt.difficulty: No plan agreed (stated absence); unresolved differential; abbreviations

any: the travel is the whole problem

07-out-of-order-grief.txt.difficulty: Scattered sections; irrelevant aside; reasoned-against diagnoses

09-intake-history-declined.txt.difficulty: History refused (stated absence); few-shot regurgitation trap

10-intake-messy-mixed.txt.difficulty: All axes; nuanced passive suicidal ideation

requiresHedge.marker: unclear in dictation|unconfirmed|uncertain|to be (?:confirmed|verified)|not confirmed|as reported

11-terse-observations-no-read.txt.difficulty: Rich Objective, no Assessment offered and none stated as withheld

12-dictated-observation-only.txt.difficulty: Explicit withholding of the read; ambivalence left unresolved; risk never raised

13-phone-check-in-no-objective.txt.difficulty: Telephone contact: nothing observed and nothing concluded; two blank sections

14-intake-long-no-formulation.txt.difficulty: Long intake, full history, formulation explicitly withheld

15-shorthand-cut-short.txt.difficulty: Session cut short: nothing concluded and nothing planned; two blank sections

16-intake-partial-no-plan.txt.difficulty: Intake with no formulation and no plan agreed; non-gendered patient

17-nothing-changed-phrase-bait.txt.difficulty: Nothing changed and nothing was agreed — bait for habitual improvement/agreement phrasing

18-long-dictation-no-read.txt.difficulty: Long; a success story with no conclusion drawn; irrelevant aside; unnamed medication

19-intake-dictated-no-formulation.txt.difficulty: Intake with garbled medication, a declined topic, and no formulation

20-two-topics-no-synthesis.txt.difficulty: Two unrelated topics the clinician explicitly did not connect
